description:
Label a few slices of a microCT volume, and IRIS trains a 2D U-Net on them and segments the whole volume slice by slice. Each run is recorded, so you can compare runs with different settings side by side.

IRIS is UNSW Research Technology Services' AI imaging gateway on the Katana cluster. Pick a dataset folder in your scratch holding volume/ (the volume's netCDF blocks) and train/images/ with train/labels/ (TIFF pairs with matching names, 0 = unlabelled). The job runs in the pre-built IRIS imaging environment, so nothing is installed.

Everything lands in <dataset>/runs/<job ID>/: labels.tif (the label volume), model.pt, params.json, metrics.json and commit.txt (the IRIS commit that ran). Cite the citable version at or before that commit, and give the commit.

Documentation: https://docs.restech.unsw.edu.au/iris/workflows/microct-2d-segmentation/
name: UNSW HPC Katana - microCT 2D Segmentation (U-Net)
